title: Ardizzi and Ferri 2018 looming versus flat hand PPS
citation: Ardizzi, M., & Ferri, F. (2018). Interoceptive influences on peripersonal space boundary. Cognition, 177, 79–86.
notes: Run the 300-trial Session 1 PPS assessment in software. The fixed 1-second intertrial silence and two synthetic level envelopes are encoded. The preview uses a tactile-channel marker and mouse response.

reference_parameters.source_scope: Session 1, tactile reaction time with either looming or flat sound. The heartbeat and time-estimation tasks are separately administered in Session 2.
reference_parameters.reported_trial_formula: 180 paired trials (two sound conditions × five SOAs × 18 repetitions), 120 sound-only catches derived from 40% of trials, three equal blocks of 100, and no tactile-only baseline.
reference_parameters.trajectory_preview_scope: The general Designer geometry is only a preview default. The stereo clips are played unchanged, and the trial pool does not encode a spatial distance for any SOA.

published_tactile_target.site: Back of the right index finger
published_tactile_target.intensity_calibration: Individual weakest clearly detectable nonpainful level above sensory threshold

reference_parameters.published_response: Speeded Cedrus RB-834 button press with the left index finger for touch; withhold on auditory-only catches.
reference_parameters.catch_allocation_default: Equal overall counts for looming and flat catches. The paper reports a combined catch proportion without the split; realized within-block condition counts and original random order are unspecified.

preview_audio.synthesis: PPS Kit continuous pink-noise generator with PCG64 seed, strip DC, normalize the shared 3-second waveform to −26 dBFS RMS before envelope, and apply 5 ms sine-squared fades at both ends.
preview_audio.looming_envelope: Linear ramp in dB over the stimulus, equivalent to exponential amplitude gain.

published_loudspeaker_setup.near_reference: Near the resting right hand. Exact hand-to-speaker separation was not specified.
published_loudspeaker_setup.locator: Cognition 177, p. 80, section 2.2, Apparatus and procedure

published_pps_analysis.rt_cells: Mean tactile reaction time at each of the five delays, separately for looming and flat sounds.
published_pps_analysis.boundary: Center in milliseconds of the fitted sigmoid for an individual participant.
published_pps_analysis.model_comparison: Compare linear and sigmoid RMSE for looming trials with a paired t test.
published_pps_analysis.locator: Cognition 177, p. 81, section 2.2, Estimation of individual PPS boundary

preview_timing.catch_response: Withhold. Any software catch timer is not a tactile onset.
preview_timing.tactile_delivery: The software marker uses the standard tactile-channel waveform. Original electrical delivery requires laboratory qualification.
preview_timing.response_input: Mouse click as a software surrogate for the left-index Cedrus RB-834 response.

reference_parameters.profile_scope: The Session 1 PPS assessment, with 300 scheduled trials across three blocks.
remaining_caveats: The two bundled pink-noise files are synthetic. The original dual-speaker gains and SPL calibration require the original lab setup.
The preview uses a tactile-channel marker and mouse button. Research delivery requires the original individually calibrated electrical pulse and Cedrus response box.
Heartbeat counting, time estimation and self-consciousness use separate procedures. Exact received catch splits and within-block order are unreported.

provenance.field: Paired SOAs, acoustic conditions, and trial counts
provenance.source: Cognition 177, pp. 80–81, §2.2 and Fig. 1. The exact target repetitions and 60:40 target-to-catch ratio give the full session counts.

Cognition 177, p. 80, §2.2. Original pink noise was synthesized at 44.1 kHz, with 55–70 dB looming or 62.5 dB flat intensity. The locally generated clips approximate the relative profiles with a common digital level reference.
Cognition 177, pp. 80–81, §2.2. Tactile onset is relative to the acoustic source. Each trial is followed by a 1000 ms interval. The recorded response used the left index finger on a Cedrus RB-834.
Cognition 177, p. 81, section 2.2, Estimation of individual PPS boundary.
